newsitem.title: GREECE: EU' SOLIDARITY MODEL HAS TO PROVE SUCCESSFUL - MATHIES.
newsitem.headline: EU' SOLIDARITY MODEL HAS TO PROVE SUCCESSFUL - MATHIES.

text.p: The European Union has to show to the rest of the world that its model of solidarity financed by structural funds is successful, said Monika Wulf-Mathies, EU commissioner for regional policies and cohesion.
"The European Union has to prove that the European model of solidarity works," said Mathies in presenting the EU's first report on economic and social cohesion in Athens.
Social cohesion and the reduction of regional disparities in income levels were the main goals of EU's structural policies, said Mathies.
But the EU commissioner stressed that the long-term goal of these structural policies was to generate self-sustained growth in the poorest EU members.

The four poorest members of the EU, Greece, Spain, Portugal and Ireland, had managed to raise their income per capita to 75 percent of the EU average from 65 percent in the 1980s thanks partly to the EU's structural policies, she said.

More than 7.0 million new jobs had been created in the EU in the last 10 years driving the employment level for women to high levels, said Mathies. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
